svg.title: Vectorized SQL engine architecture
svg.text: sql_engine static library · C++20, standard library only · single process, single thread
differential check: same plan through both engines, equal results
no CLI, server or file I/O
row at a time, logical plan
all data lives in process memory; a batch is a whole table or intermediate result plus a selection vector
